caption_note: Material treatment MISSING: painted in rusted_industrial, which is not the pack's own -- and not the family THEME_BY_GAME_HINT names either.

lamps.why: what the pendulum housing would hold -- pale, not the temple's firelight. A clock room is lit to be read, not to be atmospheric.
daylight down the shaft the opening leads to, cold
a high gleam off the works: without it the gears read as flat cut-outs

place.why: clear of the approach -- the pack dresses the room, it does not narrow the route
the works face into the room; the plate sits back in the wall
hung at reading height on the opposite wall
batch043's wall-switch contract: beside the door, at hand height, same place as T01's
off the walked line, the way something that fell and was left would be
